patches.title: Clear Unpacker state after decode errors
patches.description: Releases partially constructed map keys and nested objects and resets parser context when decoding fails, preventing a caught error followed by Unpacker reuse from dereferencing stale state.

dep3.origin: Targeted backport of the upstream parser-state cleanup to Debian's python-msgpack 1.0.3 source. The upstream patch does not apply without adaptation because Debian's older unpack_template.h uses different parser structure context.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed Debian source crashes with SIGSEGV when skip() is called after catching ValueError from malformed map input.
tests.patchedExpectation: The same error followed by skip() exits normally; malformed input remains rejected.
